title: Soil borings and testpits.
officialText:
Prior to the approval of construction documents, soil borings and testpits shall be
performed in accordance with the provisions of Section 1114.2.1 of the New York City Plumbing Code. Soil borings and testpits
shall be performed under the supervision of a special inspector. The results of the soil borings and testpits shall be filed on forms
provided by the department.
